visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven current portable views against individually viewed local Qualla front/rear originals, rear massing, porch beams, northeast corner and entry-glass detail. Final geometry keeps three porches open, exposes attic glazing above the lower roofs, restricts masonry foundations to ground-floor masses, and connects rear stair flights through retaining-wall gaps.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all seven current shared-material views including full front/back and map overlay. Cedar-shake wall, wood trim, membrane roof, concrete/gunite and brick use five shared metric surfaces, with local glass. Flat-ground fixtures expose foundation depth; independent terrain views establish actual ground contact.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all nineteen current lighting, quality and forced-detail views. Skyline retains overlapping gables and open porch voids; district restores glazing, rails and coarser exposed rafters; street adds timber frames, brackets and coarser shake courses; closeup includes finer courses, art-glass lines, chimney brackets and terrace stone variation. Synthetic neighbors are style fixtures; no physical-device performance measurement claimed.

geographicReview.notes: Anchor [-118.16094281998548,34.15164015362752], heading 1.13 radians: north-northeast +X, east-southeast/front +Z. Map controls establish main roof envelope, projecting gables and sleeping porches. Detached northeast garage excluded. Independent unmodified USGS CA_LosAngeles_B23 raster 41348 retained; datum 273.7152 m NAVD88 at front garden [2,17]. Main floor Y=1.5 and upper porches Y=4.8. Rear stairs meet raised terrace and measured higher rear ground. Source ground beneath buildings is interpolated; terrain unflattened and footprint replacement disabled.

fidelityReview.scope: Main house, three open sleeping porches and attached front/rear terraces. Detached garage excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Two primary and five supplemental local Qualla images plus HABS CA-1981 architectural description, first-floor plan, local construction detail and aerial roof context establish individual massing. Hidden roof joins, upper room boundaries and dimensions remain estimates. Shake pattern, beam profiles, art-glass branches and fieldstone are simplified. No photographs, interiors, furniture, vegetation or visitors copied.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four current levels visually inspected and within budgets. Exact triangle and byte counts are recorded in levels; error values are authoring budgets, not measured deviations.

geometryValidation.notes: Exact regeneration, ordinary import verification, four current LOD checks and strict medium-fi audit passed. Source bundle, scene and terrain schemas pass; independent terrain PNG encoding error recorded above. No independent Khronos-validator run claimed.

limitations: Original medium-fi exterior from inspected local Qualla front/rear photographs, porch and entry details, local HABS construction section, online first-floor plan and aerial roof context. Dimensions, upper room boundaries and hidden roof joins are estimates, not survey data.
Main house and attached terraces only. Detached garage, interiors, furniture, vegetation, visitors and photographic pixels excluded.
Independent unmodified USGS CA_LosAngeles_B23 bare-earth tile retained. Ground under structures is interpolated by the source product; host terrain can differ. Footprint replacement remains disabled.

Cedar shakes, art-glass branches, beam-end profiles, terrace fieldstones and chimney brackets are simplified at medium-fi scale and omitted progressively at distance. No physical-device frame-rate measurement claimed.
